hero.subhead: Acute Insight AI replaces paper forms and clunky portals with a conversational intake that adapts to each patient — talk or type, and it comes out clinically structured.

howItWorks.headline: Ask. Understand. Inform.
howItWorks.subhead: Three intelligent steps that transform patient history into clinical clarity — before the appointment begins.

steps.title: Ask
steps.subtitle: Talk or type
steps.description: Patients tell their story in their own words — by voice or text. Ace asks the right follow-ups based on each answer, and skips what doesn't apply — no irrelevant questions, no dead ends.

steps.title: Understand
steps.subtitle: AI pattern recognition
steps.description: Responses are analyzed in real-time against clinical frameworks. The system identifies patterns, flags risk factors, and builds a structured medical history automatically.

steps.title: Inform
steps.subtitle: Instant provider brief
steps.description: Providers receive a concise, structured summary before the visit — chief complaint, relevant history, medications, and AI-flagged considerations. Walk in prepared.

rows.title: AI-Adaptive Questioning
rows.description: The intake follows your answers the way a good triage conversation would. Chronic condition history triggers targeted follow-ups; straightforward concerns move quickly. No one answers questions that don't apply to them.

rows.title: Built for Completion
rows.description: Patients talk or type, whichever is easier — no wall of form fields. And the intake knows when it has enough: it stops asking instead of burning patients out.

rows.title: Instant Provider Briefing
rows.description: The moment a patient submits their intake, a structured clinical summary with flagged considerations is waiting in the provider dashboard. No chart-digging, no surprises — just focused, informed care from the first hello.

rows.title: Private by Design
rows.description: Patient data is encrypted in transit, protected by role-based access, and never sold or shared. We're building toward full HIPAA-ready infrastructure ahead of general availability — and we'll tell you exactly where we stand.

providers.subhead: Before you enter the room, Acute Insight has already gathered, structured, and summarized your patient's history. Spend your time on care — not data collection.

clinicians.body: Structured summaries, flagged risks, and a dashboard that runs in any browser. No integration required to start.
